cells.gaps: FinScope's 92% is formal financial inclusion, which counts insurance and pensions as well as accounts. No survey found since November 2023 puts adults who made or received a digital payment at 79% or more.
cells.note: FinScope 2024 finds formal financial inclusion at 92% of adults and registered mobile money accounts at 77%; the formal figure is read as account holding, as Nigeria's is, four in five or more. No survey gives the share paying digitally.
